verdict.rationale: Notte's docs say every session automatically gets clean, realistic browser fingerprints and built-in stealth features against anti-bot systems. The docs also explicitly recommend pairing stealth mode with residential proxies, and the product page advertises a global residential proxy network with fixed IPs and bring-your-own proxies. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of geo-targeting or country selection for proxies, configuration detail for enabling proxies per session, independent or hands-on corroboration that stealth and proxies actually avoid bot blocking.
